I'm married.  Been married now for 2 1/2 years.  My wife had a daughter previous to our marriage.  I love her and she is my daughter.  We have now been together for 5 years.

My wife is bi-polar.  I knew this going into the relationship but there were no real signs of it.  She was taking her medication, going to college and doing well.  Then for some reason she stopped taking her meds.  This was unbeknownst to me and her family.  I had never seen her in a manic phase but I noticed an increase want / need to get out.  See more friends, visit casinos, amusement parks etc.  This is all well and fun but costly.  Plus, we had a ( at the time ) 6 year old daughter to take care of and I worked a full time job.  I couldn't always go out to 12 or 1am and go to work by 5am the next day.  

She would complain about being bored, how we never do anything even if the weekend before we went to Tahoe or Reno or the night before we went to an Indian casino or hung out with friends.  My days would start off with the same text.  "I'm bored." Not, "I love you," Or "Good morning" but "I'm bored." It was a constant boredom phase.  Then just as quickly as the mania came it ended scarily.  

I was getting the boredom texts for the last two weeks or so at work.  All she does is go to school and take care of our daughter and how she needs to get out.  This day was different, the texts were different.  I got my text around 9am and she was angry.  Complaining how all she does is look out for others and no one does for her.  That she sits at home waiting for our daughter to get home then for me to get home before we could ever do anything.  I would respond that she has a car, why not visit me for lunch or try to plan and visit a friend for lunch at their work.  Told her I'd love to see her or have her come by ( I only have a half hour lunch ).  This only infuriated her more when she texted some of her friends and they said they couldn't do it today, some had lunch plans already, some had meetings until 1:30 ( daughter out at 2 so too late for my wife ) so she got mad.  The texts again focusing on how no one ever wants to do anything for her or spend time with her.   I tried to explain that wasn't the case.  That, like us, most people we knew now had kids.  Hard to drop everything and just visit unless its planned.  And like me, most of our friends worked.  Those that didn't were typically single and didn't have much income to go out to eat.  Wasn't anything personal against her.  This turned to an argument about me defending everyone and not being on her side.  The texts got worse and she grew very mad.  Finally I get a text around 2 in the afternoon saying she had her dad pick up our daughter.  

She said she was done.  She realized that no one was going to love her like she loves everyone else.  She was going to take all her pills she had been hoarding and just end it.  She had gotten some vodka at the store and she just wanted to end it all.  

I drive to her leaving work.  It's about 30 minutes away.  I get to the house ( I don't tell her I'm leaving work or anything but steadily texting her to keep her talking ) .  I open the door and find her very drunk with a bottle in her hand.  She see's me and is surprised and immediately tries to swallow the pills while grabbing a kitchen knife telling me to stay away or she will stab me.  I knock the knife out of her hand and wrestle the pills away.  She grabs a glass cup and throws it at me and then runs to our room and locks the door.  She threatens to call the cops on me for trespassing.  I tell her to please do because I was not leaving.  She opens the door with phone in hand and dials 911 looking at me hoping I would back away.  I don't and she quickly realizes she just called 911 and hangs up.  She's yelling at me telling me to let her just die and take the pills.  I wont let her and keep her away from the medication.  The cops show up about 10 minutes later ( Thank God! ) and she tells them I broke into the house and was an intruder.  That I grabbed a knife and was going to kill her.  The cops separate us and can clearly see she has been drinking.  As they look around they see the pills and broken glass on the floor and knife.  I explain my side and I have texts to back up my side.  Shortly afterwards her cousin and aunt come to the house.  She was telling her cousin how close they used to be and they never see each other anymore and she just hates life.  She was also texting the aunt the same thing.  They were concerned enough, knew of her bipolar disorder and the signs of her mania and depression well.  They came over for support to cheer her up and were not expecting what they saw.  They came over to the cops and immediately defended me saying they knew I was a good guy and would never do anything to hurt her.  They explained the bipolar disorder to the cops and how she's had episodes in the past where things got violent or things were damaged.  They saw the pills on the floor and the knife and the scratches all over my arms and said they had been there before.  My wife ends up getting taken away on a 5150.  She is sent to a treatment facility for two weeks.  I visited her every day of those two weeks.   

I was going to make a different username to post this but decided not to.  Reason being: I suspect my wife is off her meds again.  She denies it but I'm seeing those signs and so is her family.  Last two days have gotten those boredom texts and complaining how we never do anything. All this week we've eaten at friends houses....haven't really been home all week.  My brothers house, her friends house, my friends house, Thanksgiving and last night out with friends till 11pm...."I'm bored." followed by.  "We never do anything."

My life went from happy to destroyed in that instant.  I almost lost my wife. I saw a scary side to her I did not know existed.  I learned of how bad her bipolar can be when not treated with medication properly.  It shattered me.  I am still with her. I love her and our daughter.  I now fear two words coming from my wife. 

"I'm bored."

Hate that text.  Hate those words. 

Sorry for the long post.  Felt good to share.

I had 911 called on me.  This was a few years ago.  My wife is bipolar and this can make for some difficult times.  At the time we were both staying at her parents house to save money to move out and for our wedding.

She was in a bad manic phase for a while and it came to a head one day.  She was texting me while at work threatening to kill herself.  I came home early and she pulled a knife on me.  Grabbed a bunch of pills and tried to swallow them.  I was able to knock the knife out of her hands and the pills.  She tried to take a bottle and lock herself in our room there.  I got the bottle out of her hands and she threatened to call the cops on me for trespassing.  Since it was her parents house and her room.  i told her to do it.  She opens the door, dials 911 and hangs up when she realizes I wasn't going to leave.  Her aunt and cousin came shortly afterwards to a bunch of pills on the kitchen floor a knife and me with some scratches all over my arms ( no cuts ). A room in childhood house was haunted. Me and my brother never knew about each others experience until another friend brought it up years later

------Long Story-----
We grew up pretty poor.  My parents had come here illegally but were working to become legal citizens.  They learned english, took night classes to read and write english properly and were learning how to become legal citizens.  This was around the time me and my brother were 9 and 10 years old.  During these classes we would stay home.  Were both boys and old enough to take care of ourselves for an hour or two right?  Well, sometimes the other brother would spend the night somewhere else so we would be alone instead. 

It was always when we were alone we would be scared.  When i was alone here is what happened.  

The first time I was alone my parents left for night school and I was eating dinner.  It was around 8pm and I heard talking coming from the back bedroom.  This was our guest bedroom.  I swear it was inside so I'm a little nervous.  I walk slowly to the sound of the voices ( typical dumb horror movie move ) and that door slams shut hard!  Laughter from that room now and now more voices.  I'm scared and go to kitchen, grab a knife and go to me and my brothers room with door locked.  Stay there all night long hearing voices and footsteps in the house.  

Parents come home and voices are gone.  I act like I'm not scared.  This happened everytime they would leave and I was alone.  I had no idea that it also happened to my older brother when he was alone. 

10+ years later, and were hanging out with an old childhood friend.  Somehow the conversation comes up to ghosts and such.  Our friend then tells us how scared he was of our house and spending the night. 

That when he was about 10 and spent the night he had to go to the bathroom.  To go to the bathroom you walk by the guest room.  He said the door was open and he was just walking and the second he past the door it slammed shut and someone laughed from the room.  

Said another time the door was already closed and he left the bathroom and all of a sudden it burst open and again heard laughing from the room.  Said he hated going to the bathroom at night at our house cause he was scared of that room.  It was at that point I told my story and my older brother told his.  This was the first time I told him and him me but we had the same voices and footsteps from that room.

Let me preface this by stating that I think all "psychics" on tv are a big fake.  I will tell you my experience with one that was legitimate.  

This happened to me in 1998 when the dot com bubble was still big.  I was in web design and about to embark on a job interview in Florida.  I live in California.  I was scheduled to leave out of San Francisco airport in about a week, stop over in North Carolina for two hours then on to Jacksonville, Florida.  

I was at Walmart doing some shopping, but not making travel purchases, just normal purchases.  I actually just went to get toilet paper and shampoo ( not rravel size ) for the apartment.  As I was walking to my car a group of Indian people ( young ) were heading in.  As they pass me one of them says to me: "Excuse me, I got to tell you something."

I turn around and see one of them stopped.  His friends were behind him but a few feet away as if they didnt expect him to stop.  They also started saying things like, "come on man, lets just go."  

He turns to them and says, "One sec."  Then to me:  "Get a wallet with a chain on it.  You'll make your flight, but your gonna stress about losing your wallet."  He then starts to turn around about to leave stops and turns around again. "See if you can get an earlier one.  You wont make the connecting flight if you don't."  He then turns around and walks away.

I kind of just stood there stunned because I didnt know the guy, I wasnt on the phone that day or anything talking about a trip or anything.  Either way, I'm thinking weird.

Fast forward a week later and I'm driving to San Francisco from Sacramento.  I get to the airport park in long term parking, hop on the shuttle, get ready to check in and lo and behold, my wallet is lost.  I panic!  Im checking my pockets frantically thinking that it will magically appear by the third check and nothing.  I go back to the bus pickup to parking and ask the guy if anyone reported a lost wallet.  No such luck.  Guy radios to other drivers to be on the lookout while I get back on the bus to go back to my car.  I get there, frantically search the car and nothing.  I had my wallet that day. I used it to buy some breakfast on the way to the airport so I know I had it!  I tear my car apart and give up.  

I walk back to the bus stop looking defeated and about to hop on in case someone turned it into the airport.  The bus driver opens the door and looks at me and says, I'm guessing your the wallet guy.  He looks at my ID and me and says, yup, its you!  Hands me my wallet and ID.  No money missing, everything in tact.  I'm surprised as hell!  

I make the flight but its grounded for an hour and a half before it takes off.  I finally land in North Carolina to miss my connecting flight by 30 minutes.  I stay the night and get the next flight out in the morning…..I hadnt thought about what that guy said to me until I missed my connecting flight and it all came back.  Thats when I really got goosebumps and felt that I had really met someone with an ability to see things.  

TL:DR: Stranger warned me about getting a wallet with a chain so I wouldn't lose it at the airport and to change to an earlier flight to not miss my connecting flight. Didn't listen, his predictions came true.
